name: Thierry
source:
A modern-day prince from a long lineage, though his title now holds little power.

He is seen by the public as pleasant and diplomatic, although people close to him often describe his true personality as "snarky, cynical, and a little bit bossy".

Likes: Sleeping in, expensive things
Dislikes: Meetings that could've been done over email

"I'm good at public speaking, raising taxes, signing bills... hm? One of those isn't like the others? I'm not quite sure what you mean, detective."

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3048330/Mirage_Noir/]Steam[/url]]
